reason: After thorough review of the Adient plc 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025 (ended September 30, 2025), no total addressable market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive financial data, segment information for Americas, EMEA, and Asia regions, customer concentration metrics (Ford, Volkswagen, Stellantis), and operational details about automotive seating manufacturing. However, the company did not publish any market size estimates, industry TAM figures, or addressable market opportunity assessments in this regulatory document.
